SELECT v.document_id, v.title, v.source_type, v.status, v.source_version, v.chunk_count, v.created_at FROM public.nw_knowledge_documents d JOIN public.nw_knowledge_document_versions v ON v.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND v.document_id = d.id AND v.source_version = d.current_source_version WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
AND v.status = #{status}
AND strpos(lower(v.title), lower(#{titleQuery})) > 0
ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC

SELECT v.source_version FROM public.nw_knowledge_documents d JOIN public.nw_knowledge_document_versions v ON v.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND v.document_id = d.id AND v.source_version = d.current_source_version WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 'ready' ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT 2000

SELECT count(*) FROM nw_knowledge_document_versions v WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.kb_id=#{kbId} AND v.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND v.status='ready' AND v.chunk_count>0 AND v.chunk_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM knowledge_chunk_values c WHERE c.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND c.document_id=v.document_id AND c.source_version=v.source_version) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_chunk_values c WHERE c.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND c.document_id=v.document_id AND c.source_version=v.source_version AND (c.embedding IS NULL OR vector_dims(c.embedding)<>#{dimensions}))
